messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Information Provision" as it appears in the following examples.
['We would like to notify you that NatWest bank carries out customer data verification procedure that is compulsory for all NatWest bank customers.', 'To avoid any possible threat, your account has been disabled.', 'Your e-mail address, attached to winning numbers 16,18,29,33,37,42,35 consequently won in the First Category.', 'You have 2 unread message(s)...', 'We recently noticed that a transaction may have been made without your knowledge or consent.', 'our records indicate that your account was Flagged and has upshot an internal error on our processor.', 'We notice something unusual with your USAA personal details.', 'We have noticed an illegal money transfer from your HSBC UK internet banking account,', 'Access to your accounts have been blocked.', 'You have received this email because someone had tried to use your PayPal account at http://www.1-bulk-email-mailing-address-list.com', 'In this manner for your security, your specified access account has been locked and needs to be reactivated, in order for it to remain active, please Use the link below to proceed and unlock your account.', 'You have a new not paid bill from FedEx that is ready for payment.', 'After the last annual calculations of your fiscal activity we have determined that you are eligible to receive a tax refund of 304.73 AUD', 'As part of the new security measures, all Capital One Bank business customers (including all former customers of North Fork bank) are required to complete Towered Form (or Treasury Optimizer Form).', 'We are sorry to inform you that due to the number of incorrect login attempts, you account has been locked for security.', 'Your order has been successfully canceled.', 'our calculations show that you have made over payments of GBP 178.25', 'Your mailbox is almost full.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
